concerns.text: T104 never states the Monte Carlo iteration count for the sweep. Spec FR-003 mandates 500; plan.md targets 2000 ('2000 iterations x 72 conditions'); T102 uses 500. An implementer cannot deterministically execute T104 — the run time, output row counts, and FDR/Binomial power all depend on this number. State the exact n_iterations in T104 (or name the config field + its authoritative source).

T101 requires downloading 'the RCT datasets from OpenML via the openml package using explicit dataset IDs' but no dataset IDs are named in tasks.md, plan.md, or spec.md (plan says only 'verified OpenML IDs (e.g., representative examples)'). The implementer has no authoritative list; the task is not self-contained. Name the concrete OpenML dataset IDs (and treatment/outcome/covariate column mappings) in T101 or a referenced artifact.

T109's verification 'a single fresh run reproduces the recorded results within Monte Carlo tolerance given fixed seeds' does not define the tolerance or the comparison procedure (which statistic, what bound). Make it checkable, e.g. 'each re-run Type I error rate within ±X of the recorded value' or 'identical outputs given fixed seeds'.

T106 bundles three distinct verifiable deliverables (run CC/MI/IPW comparison across the sweep; verify SC-005 cc_mi_ratio/validated_tipping_point outputs; verify FR-009 covariate-correlation assertion and validation_status recording). Too coarse for deterministic execution — split so each has its own artifact and check.
'Create code/main_us1.py (or extend the existing orchestration in code/main.py)' leaves the deliverable path ambiguous. Pick one so the verification command in quickstart.md is deterministic.
